bugs.title: No immediate feedback when a stage is dispatched
bugs.notes: Every stage-triggering action (Stage A start, Stage B start, restart, any other dispatch) must immediately show an animated/progressing 'starting...' indicator BEFORE the dispatch completes. New message on user-initiated actions, edit on button-driven state changes, per existing rules.

bugs.title: Pasted production.json — spurious 'send the rest' prompt and no chat cleanup
bugs.notes: 1) Bot tells user to send remaining parts even when all split bubbles already arrived and full JSON assembled successfully right after — must not appear if bot will succeed anyway. 2) After full production.json accepted across split bubbles, delete all user message bubbles to avoid chat clutter (only after confirmed successful parse/acceptance).

bugs.title: Music upload should support multi-file batch with explicit Done
bugs.notes: After tapping 'Add Music File', bot must tell user they can send as many music files as they want, then tap a 'Done' button when finished. Collect all sent files during this window, finalize/attach only once Done is tapped.

bugs.title: Help page — missing setup instructions, remove images
bugs.notes: Replaced the Telegra.ph page: published 'ClipForge Bot - Setup & User Guide' (https://telegra.ph/ClipForge-Bot--Setup--User-Guide-08-27) via the Telegraph API. ADDED the missing onboarding: GitHub account creation, repo setup via the bot's Create-Shadow-Clone/Connect flow (no manual fork needed), and classic-PAT creation with the minimum scopes (repo + workflow) incl. an ASCII diagram. REMOVED all images (the old placehold.co mockups); page is text-only with ASCII art. Bot views.js HELP_GUIDE_URL now points at the new page; helpKeyboard label de-'screenshots'ed; Connect-existing-clone prompt links the setup guide. Edit token recorded in docs/HELP_GUIDE.md.

bugs.title: Remove AI/Gemini automatic script-generation mode entirely
bugs.notes: Removed the Gemini automatic script-generation mode end-to-end. Bot: wizard mode step is Manual-only (modeKeyboard/stepPrompt/describeMode), wz:mode always sets manual, Gemini settings sub-screen + gemini_key flow + handleGeminiKeyMessage removed, geminiKeys dropped from putCredentials/connect/create flows, home/settings screens no longer show Gemini. github.js: buildStageARequest forces mode='manual'; makeJobId always 'manual-<ts>'. Pipeline: stage-a.yml automatic-analysis branch (Gemini SDK install, asset download, analysis, auto Stage-B dispatch) and the bug-17 fallback handler removed; awaiting_plan/commit-final-status now unconditional. stage-b.yml series auto-continuation made inert (bot 'Start next part' is the only chainer). Left intact for safety/compat: mode enums in jobs.js + schemas (legacy statuses may still carry them), Zernio automatic PUBLISHING (explicitly out of scope, untouched), and the manual diagnostics workflow's Gemini capability probe (operator-run only, never reachable from bot). Tests: 92/92 bot tests pass after updating wizard/relay fixtures.

bugs.title: Clone-update-push — wrong account can see/trigger it, updates wrong target
bugs.notes: Re-verified bug-21: the previous sweep's 'Sync from source' was visible to EVERY connected clone (no main-account gate) and a main-account tap would sync the source INTO itself. Fixed both. (1) Visibility: Settings > GitHub clone now shows 'Publish update to clones' ONLY when credentials.repo == the original repo (ORIGINAL_CLIPFORGE_REPOSITORY / motionssalt/clipforge); plain clones see 'Sync from source'. (2) Direction: a true server-side push into other users' private clones is impossible with per-user PATs, so the main account PUBLISHES the update (source ref + changelog in docs/update_notice.json, which the bot shows back to the main owner) and each clone pulls via Sync from source; syncapply refuses to run on the main account. (3) Clone-side changelog: maybeAnnounceCloneUpdate reads docs/update_notice.json from the clone repo and, on a new published_at, posts a fresh 'update available' message with the changelog once per clone (KV-tracked).

bugs.title: Telegram relay download broken — missing GH_TOKEN for source ingest
bugs.notes: Root cause confirmed: the 'Ingest source' step in stage-a.yml had no GH_TOKEN/GITHUB_TOKEN in env, and ingest.py's _download_relay_asset requires it to fetch the temporary clipforge-relay-input-<job> prerelease asset -> 'ingest error: telegram_relay source needs GH_TOKEN', exit 2, no source uploaded, Stage B later reports the asset missing. Fix: added GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }} (the same scoped credential the sibling release steps already use; workflow has contents:write) to the ingest step env. Verified in sandbox: without GH_TOKEN the exact reported error raises; with it the code proceeds past the token gate into the release fetch (404 handled correctly). NOT verified against a live telegram_relay run (needs real Telegram relay + secrets); the 2 pre-existing test_stage_a relay tests fail in this sandbox only due to low-disk preflight (fails BEFORE the token path), and test_status::test_refuses_to_leave_terminal_state is a pre-existing failure from the bug-13/15 restart change.
